shared_elements: rounded-topped upright stone monument (tall, tapering silhouette)
shallow incised/low-relief geometric ornament on the stone face
horizontal band of repeated motifs crossing the surface
vertical axial element dividing the upper field
justification: Both are upright rounded-topped stone blocks whose faces carry shallow carved ornament organised into an upper field with a vertical axis and a horizontal band of repeated units lower down, which is the most specific correspondence. However, A is a flat slab bearing a purely linear, essentially two-dimensional incised design (rendered as an ink drawing), while B is a fully modelled three-dimensional figure with a projecting head, shoulders and arms and bold curvilinear relief including discs, so the carving technique and subject differ fundamentally.
